name: Brood Whelp
description: a brimstone whelp, a young demon of the Cracked Road the size of a dog, on four stubby clawed legs: cracked black basalt hide with thin orange glowing seams, two stubby charred horns, a big jaw glowing like a furnace, a short rock tail, bigger and fatter, its swollen belly glowing with smaller whelps curled inside like eggs

poses.stand: standing on four stubby legs, its swollen glowing belly hanging low
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: bursting open in a puff of rock dust with tiny glowing whelp shapes tumbling out

idle.action: stands panting, its belly pulsing with the shapes of whelps inside

move.action: waddles fast forward on its stubby legs, belly swinging, staying in the same spot in the frame

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
